description: tools/test-projects/web-keys-audio (WEB_PROJECT=web-keys-audio tools/build.sh web): with Chrome's desktop autoplay policy the page's audio waits for a gesture; the first key press (CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent, trusted) starts it, and Meta, ContextMenu and events without a code (legacy keyCode 224 and 8) reach the game as D_KEY_LEFT_SUPER, D_KEY_RIGHT_SUPER, D_KEY_MENU, D_KEY_LEFT_SUPER, D_KEY_BACKSPACE (platform-lifecycle spec D10, D11). No pixel check: the scene is empty.
eval_before_input: (window.miniaudio && window.miniaudio.devices || []).filter(d => d && d.webaudio).map(d => d.webaudio.state).join(',') || 'no audio device'
eval: (window.miniaudio && window.miniaudio.devices || []).filter(d => d && d.webaudio).map(d => d.webaudio.state).join(',') || 'no audio device'
